penzance_bookseller.text: Browse away. The Cornwall shelf is the biggest, and the most argued over.
Penzance comes from the Cornish 'Pen Sans', which means Holy Headland.
Sir Humphry Davy was born here in 1778. He invented a safety lamp for miners in 1815.
Gilbert and Sullivan's Pirates of Penzance had its big premiere in 1879, in New York. Penzance never got over it.
